INTERNATIONAL DAY OF EDUCATION 2025
Overview
Kakatiya University
, Warangal, proudly observed the International Day of Education with a series of inspiring events aimed at promoting the power of learning and knowledge. The celebrations brought together students, faculty, and educational experts to emphasize the university’s commitment to academic excellence and innovation in education.
The event featured keynote speeches by distinguished academicians, panel discussions on the future of education, and interactive workshops on skill development and research opportunities. Students actively participated in essay competitions, debates, and cultural programs that highlighted the importance of inclusive and quality education.
Kakatiya University
, known for its strong academic foundation and diverse learning resources, continues to empower students with quality education and research opportunities. The International Day of Education celebrations reinforced the university’s dedication to fostering a knowledgeable and progressive society.
